self-hosted.attribution: Programs that publish their own policy or security.txt.
self-hosted.reason: The policy page is the program owner own page; the feed links to it and records facts about it.

hackerone.attribution: Program data from HackerOne public program pages.
hackerone.reason: General Terms allow use only in a permitted manner and no redistribution grant exists. Needs written permission.

bugcrowd.attribution: Program data from Bugcrowd public program pages.
bugcrowd.reason: Website terms forbid copying and redistribution of any portion of the website. Needs written permission.

intigriti.attribution: Program data from Intigriti public program pages.
intigriti.reason: No redistribution grant found; the official API needs an account token. Needs written permission.

yeswehack.attribution: Program data from YesWeHack public program pages.
yeswehack.reason: Legal notices forbid redistributing the platform data. Needs written permission.

immunefi.attribution: Program data from Immunefi public program pages.
immunefi.reason: Terms of use forbid automated access without written consent. Needs written permission.

hackenproof.attribution: Program data from HackenProof public program pages.
hackenproof.reason: No official machine-readable listing or redistribution grant. Needs written permission.

federacy.attribution: Program data from Federacy public program pages.

openbugbounty.attribution: Program data from Open Bug Bounty.
openbugbounty.reason: Listing is behind bot protection; no redistribution grant found.

whitehub.reason: No official listing or redistribution grant found.

bugbase.reason: No official listing or redistribution grant found.
